title: verification_receipt
description: Records the result of independently replaying a run and comparing it to a claimed run_receipt. PASS only if all comparisons match.

verified_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when verification was performed.

payload_sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest recomputed by the verifier from canonical payload bytes.

payload_crc16_ccitt_false.description: CRC-16/CCITT-FALSE recomputed by the verifier from canonical payload bytes.

claimed_result.description: Result declared in the run_receipt under verification.

replayed_result.description: Result produced by the independent replay.

matched_payload_hash.description: True if the verifier-recomputed SHA-256 matches the run_receipt's payload_sha256.

matched_payload_crc16.description: True if the verifier-recomputed CRC-16 matches the run_receipt's payload_crc16_ccitt_false.

matched_output.description: True if replayed output exactly matches the claimed output in the run_receipt.

matched_exit_code.description: True if replayed exit_code matches the claimed exit_code in the run_receipt.

verification_result.description: PASS only if all match flags are true and all comparisons succeed.

notes.description: Informational notes from the verifier. Non-empty indicates issues.
